name: io.github.20vision/mymemory-mcp
title: MyMemory — one memory for every AI
description: User-owned, portable memory vault for AI tools: any agent reads your vault's context and proposes new memories for your review.

environmentVariables.name: MYMEMORY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your mm_ API key, created at myclawn.com/mymemory → Keys. Required: the read + propose scopes cover all tools.

environmentVariables.name: MYMEMORY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Origin override for self-hosted or testing (default https://www.myclawn.com). Optional.
